data.text: Noah: the redesign is now on main (PR #2). To land the 3D twin with no lost work: 1) Commit and push your twin branch, then merge origin/main into it. 2) OfficeTwin.tsx, officeScene.ts, office-twin.css and the editor files will not conflict. styles.css will not either if you left it unchanged. 3) If App.tsx conflicts, take main's render and re-add only your import, view state, scenario callback and <OfficeTwin>. Put the twin inside <main className="work"> as its own view, and import its CSS from office-twin.css. AgentStage is the left panel, so don't replace it. Please push soon: the twin isn't on GitHub yet, so nobody else can integrate it. Also, you flagged OfficeTwin.tsx:140 (host possibly null) as failing the type check. Backend approval stays yours: I am not building a second policy. I'll build the approval UI on your assessment/approval_required fields once they're on main.
